name: Adult finger to coin slope and finger notches

datums.description: slope surface and every recess finger notch

allowed: sweep coins across the slope with the flat of a hand
pick one coin via its notch
constrained: contact with a sharp or burred edge

assembly.sequence_notes: The slope is the defining usability feature: coins must not need fingernails.

dimensions.feature: minimum wall, three perimeters at the 0.4 mm nozzle

keepouts_and_access: Not a toy; coins are a choking hazard for children and the product carries no child-use scope.

evidence.uncertainty_note: Notch geometry is a usability decision with no measured basis; it needs a real-hand test.

failure_modes.mode: A coin sits flush in its recess and cannot be picked without a fingernail.
failure_modes.effect: Daily annoyance that defeats the pocket-emptying purpose.
failure_modes.mitigation: A finger notch on every recess, sized and then verified by a real-hand test.

acceptance_criteria: Every denomination can be picked out with a bare fingertip, without a fingernail.
No user-reachable edge is sharp to a bare-hand wipe.
